patch:
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ runs:
     # native Racket terminal implementation and do not need an X display.
 
     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
-    # The package-visible compile boundary is mandatory. We separate link/
+    # Package setup: the package-visible compile boundary is mandatory. We separate link/
     # dependency acquisition from `raco setup`: an exact cache hit relinks q
     # to this checkout, verifies the reviewed dependency graph, then compiles
     # every q collection without rebuilding documentation.
@@ -70,11 +70,16 @@ runs:
         echo "Working directory: $PWD"
         echo "PLTADDONDIR: ${PLTADDONDIR:?PLTADDONDIR must be configured}"
         echo "Racket package cache hit: ${{ steps.racket-addon-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}"
+        echo "::group::Racket toolchain diagnostics"
+        raco help >/dev/null
+        echo "::endgroup::"
+        echo "Package state:"
+        raco pkg show --scope user q || true
         echo ""
 
         if [ "${{ steps.racket-addon-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}" = "true" ]; then
           if ! raco pkg show --scope user q >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-            echo "::error::Exact Racket cache hit lacks the q user package; bump the cache schema or repair ci/racket-package-lock.rktd."
+            echo "::error::Exact Racket cache hit lacks the q user package; bump the cache schema or repair ci/racket-package-lock.rktd. Reproduce locally with: racket scripts/ci-package-setup.rkt --preflight"
             exit 1
           fi
 
@@ -83,11 +88,25 @@ runs:
           echo "::endgroup::"
 
           echo "::group::Relinking q to the checked-out source without global setup"
+          set +e
           raco pkg update --name q --link --batch --no-setup "$PWD"
+          UPDATE_RC=$?
+          set -e
+          if [ "$UPDATE_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
+            echo "::error::q relink failed (UPDATE_RC=$UPDATE_RC). Reproduce locally with: racket scripts/ci-package-setup.rkt --preflight"
+            exit "$UPDATE_RC"
+          fi
           echo "::endgroup::"
         else
           echo "::group::Installing reviewed q dependencies without global setup"
+          set +e
           raco pkg install --name q --auto --batch --no-setup --no-docs "$PWD"
+          INSTALL_RC=$?
+          set -e
+          if [ "$INSTALL_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
+            echo "::error::q dependency installation failed (INSTALL_RC=$INSTALL_RC). Reproduce locally with: racket scripts/ci-package-setup.rkt --preflight"
+            exit "$INSTALL_RC"
+          fi
           echo "::endgroup::"
 
           echo "::group::Verifying freshly resolved dependency lock"
